name: tooltrim
description: tooltrim reduces the tokens agents spend re-reading bloated tool results. Run it as an MCP server exposing compress and expand_tool_output, or as a gateway in front of any upstream MCP server: it re-exposes the upstream tools unchanged and shrinks each result (HTML/JSON/logs/tables) before it reache
